question: Who has been appointed as the President of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for FY 2025-26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Memani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Rajiv Memani** has been appointed as the President of the **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** for the financial year **2025-26**.

• The **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** is a premier business association in India, working to create and sustain a conducive environment for India's development by partnering with industry, government, and civil society.

• **Rajiv Memani** is the **Chairman and Regional Managing Partner** of **Ernst & Young (EY)**, a leading global consulting firm. He is highly regarded for his expertise in business strategy and regulatory affairs.

• As the newly appointed CII President, **Rajiv Memani** will focus on driving initiatives that promote industrial growth, innovation, and sustainability in India's business ecosystem.

• The appointment was announced during a formal session of the **CII**, aligning with its tradition of leaders
